metadata.description: Two-office corporate network (HQ + branch) with AWS cloud hub. Each office has a full network stack (router, firewall, switch, VPN gateway, NAS, NVR + IP cameras, access control, POS, VoIP, WiFi AP, user clients). Both offices connect to AWS via site-to-site VPN. AWS hosts S3 backup buckets for NAS and video footage. Remote staff connect via client VPN to access company backups.

elements.name: ISP (Office 1)
elements.description: Internet service provider for the HQ office. Provides WAN uplink to the HQ router

elements.name: ISP (Office 2)
elements.description: Internet service provider for the branch office. Provides WAN uplink to the branch router

elements.name: Remote Users
elements.description: Company staff working remotely. Connect to the AWS VPN gateway via client VPN to access NAS backup and shared resources

elements.name: Office 1 — HQ
elements.description: Headquarters office LAN. Full network stack including security systems, POS, VoIP, and a VPN gateway tunnelling to AWS

elements.name: Router (HQ)
elements.description: Edge router at HQ. WAN uplink to ISP1, LAN downlink to the HQ firewall

elements.name: Firewall (HQ)
elements.description: Network firewall enforcing traffic policies between WAN and the HQ LAN

elements.name: Switch (HQ)
elements.description: Core HQ switch. Distributes traffic to all wired devices and the access point

elements.name: VPN Gateway (HQ)
elements.description: VPN gateway at HQ. Establishes an encrypted site-to-site tunnel to the AWS VPN gateway. Routes backup traffic for NAS and NVR to AWS S3

elements.name: NAS (HQ)
elements.description: Shared file storage for HQ. Wired to the switch. Backs up data to the AWS S3 NAS backup bucket via the VPN tunnel

elements.name: NVR (HQ)
elements.description: Network Video Recorder at HQ. Stores local security camera footage and replicates video archives to the AWS S3 video archive bucket via VPN

elements.name: Security Cameras (HQ)
elements.description: IP security cameras at HQ, powered via PoE from the switch. Stream video to the HQ NVR

elements.name: Access Control (HQ)
elements.description: Badge reader and door controller server managing physical access at HQ. Wired to the switch

elements.name: POS Terminal (HQ)
elements.description: Point-of-sale terminal at HQ. Wired to the switch

elements.name: VoIP Phones (HQ)
elements.description: Wired VoIP phones at HQ, connected to the switch

elements.name: Access Point (HQ)
elements.description: Wireless access point at HQ providing WiFi connectivity to laptops

elements.name: User Clients (HQ)
elements.description: Employee laptops at HQ, connecting wirelessly via the access point

elements.name: Office 2 — Branch
elements.description: Branch office LAN. Scaled-down network stack with VPN gateway connecting to the AWS hub

elements.name: Router (Branch)
elements.description: Edge router at the branch. WAN uplink to ISP2, LAN downlink to the branch firewall

elements.name: Firewall (Branch)
elements.description: Network firewall at the branch office

elements.name: Switch (Branch)
elements.description: Core branch switch. Distributes traffic to all wired devices and the access point

elements.name: VPN Gateway (Branch)
elements.description: VPN gateway at the branch. Establishes an encrypted site-to-site tunnel to the AWS VPN gateway

elements.name: NAS (Branch)
elements.description: Shared file storage for the branch. Backs up data to AWS S3 via the VPN tunnel

elements.name: NVR (Branch)
elements.description: Network Video Recorder at the branch. Replicates video archives to AWS S3 video archive via VPN

elements.name: Security Cameras (Branch)
elements.description: IP security cameras at the branch, powered via PoE. Stream video to the branch NVR

elements.name: POS Terminal (Branch)
elements.description: Point-of-sale terminal at the branch office

elements.name: Access Point (Branch)
elements.description: Wireless access point at the branch providing WiFi connectivity

elements.name: User Clients (Branch)
elements.description: Employee laptops at the branch, connecting wirelessly via the access point

elements.name: AWS Cloud
elements.description: AWS cloud hub. Hosts VPN gateway, NAS backup bucket, and video archive bucket. Acts as the central hub in a hub-and-spoke VPN topology connecting both offices and remote users

elements.name: AWS VPN Gateway
elements.technology: AWS Virtual Private Gateway / Client VPN
elements.description: AWS VPN gateway. Terminates site-to-site tunnels from both offices and client VPN connections from remote users. Routes authenticated traffic to the S3 backup buckets

elements.name: S3 NAS Backup
elements.description: S3 object storage bucket for NAS backups. Receives backup jobs from both office NAS systems via the VPN tunnel. Accessible to remote users via company VPN

elements.name: S3 Video Archive
elements.description: S3 / Glacier bucket for video footage archival. Receives video backup exports from both office NVRs via VPN. Long-term retention for compliance and security review
